source.name: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory, Nitrous Oxide Trends

refresh_policy.notes: Treat this as a benchmark snapshot for atmospheric N2O trend support. Refresh on NOAA trend-page updates rather than presenting it as a live chemistry feed.

use_guidance.primary_role: Support nitrous-oxide nodes with an official atmospheric benchmark layer and direct routing to the global budget literature.
use_guidance.caution: Use this for anchor calibration and trend framing. Do not infer local emissions or real-time atmospheric conditions from this bundle.

overview.title: NOAA nitrous oxide trend support
overview.description: NOAA GML maintains long-run atmospheric N2O trend surfaces built from global flask measurements and benchmark trend analysis.
